concepts.title: Central core with service loop
concepts.prompt: Create one empty roofless interior concept for Station Zero, a strictly 2D illustrated Mars-colony game. Painted 2D art, crisp dark contours, restrained texture, warm ivory pressure panels, charcoal equipment, ochre highlights and orange reflected light. Use the same fixed oblique orthographic camera for every room: approximately 35-degree elevation, floor axes approximately 30 degrees to horizontal, no perspective convergence. Keep back walls and low front cutaway walls; reveal the whole usable floor. Center one complete enclosed module on flat pale warm-gray with clear margins. Doorway centered on the nearest front edge. Upper-left light, soft local shadows, no long exterior shadow. Consistent adult-scale beds, counters, chairs and doors; main aisles fit two adults. Clearly separate equipment footprints from floor and leave reachable approaches. No people, Sims, robots, captions, labels, watermarks, terrain, sky, translucent footprint rectangle or ghost exterior. Screens use abstract indicators. No 3D-rendered look or photorealism. Single concept, not a sheet of views. Design a reinforced rectangular Reactor interior around one compact, prominent amber-glowing cylindrical generator on a raised sealed base at the center. Define its machinery footprint with a narrow hazard-striped service boundary; nobody walks on the base. A continuous wide circulation loop runs outside that boundary and connects the front entry to both side walls. Place a two-position monitoring console against the left wall, two separated inspection panels on the right wall, and neatly routed cooling pipes and cable trunks along the back wall. Leave clear standing space directly in front of each console and panel. Low bolted equipment housings and gray metal floor panels convey reliability rather than a dangerous exposed furnace. Keep the glow restrained so console surfaces and floor boundaries are readable. All wiring belongs to equipment or wall edges, never draped across the walking route. Amber is the functional accent.
notes: Reachable uses: check left console, inspect right service panel, pause outside the central hazard boundary.
Power production is automatic; no operator staffing requirement is proposed.
Variant A compares a central machine and a continuous service loop.
